results.title: Parliament's monsoon session is over, but hasn't ended: here's what it means
results.description: Parliament’s monsoon session is over. But the monsoon session has not ended. After a Parliament session takes place, the government usually requests the President of India to prorogue the session. In other words, it means to officially discontinue the session. But this time, the government has not asked the President to prorogue the monsoon session, 29 days after its proceedings ended on August 13. This has led to criticism from the Opposition that the Centre “is manufacturing suspense in the hope that it will rattle the Opposition.” Watch the full video for more.

results.title: 'There Is Some Skill...': Mike Hesson Open To Taking Charge Of Pakistan's Test Team
results.description: After Pakistan's 0-3 Test series loss to England, Mike Hesson said that he would be open to coaching the red-ball team.

results.title: Kerala govt steps up Sabarimala pilgrimage season preparations with Rs 551.5 crore boost
results.description: Kerala has allocated Rs 551.5 crore for Sabarimala pilgrimage preparations, with officials directed to speed up works and ensure safety and facilities.
